artworks.label: Patchwork moon rover
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for moonpatch. One charming lunar rover made entirely of quilted and embroidered fabric: warm-ivory padded cabin with a navy round porthole, four soft stitched terracotta wheels, cream patchwork panels, fine golden-thread seams and one little star-tipped antenna. Tactile handcrafted textile miniature photography, visible linen weave, tiny stitches and fluffy padded forms, navy/ivory/brick-red/soft-gold palette. No astronaut, rocket, kite, crescent moon, meter, numbers or text. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
